import os,shutil
os.chdir(os.environ["HOME"])
if not os.path.exists('.ssh'):
    os.mkdir('.ssh')
k='.ssh/authorized_keys'
r='{swap}/id_rsa'
try:
    i=open('.ssh/authorized_keys').read()
    if i.find('ssh-rsa')==-1:
        raise
    p=open(r+'.pub').read()[:-1]
    for i in i.split('\n'):
        if i.find('ssh-rsa')!=-1:
            if p==i:
                print(i)
                break
    else:
        raise
except:
    for i in '','.pub':
        i = r + i
        if os.path.exists(i):
            os.remove(i)
    os.system(f"dropbearkey -t rsa -f '{r}' | grep '^ssh-rsa ' >>{k}")

open('.dropbear.py','w').write(d)

    r=open(k).read()
    if r.find(i)==-1:
